address: The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, #B1-15 & L1-83, 10 Bayfront Avenue, 018956, Singapore
bio: Located in the shopping mall at Marina Bay Sands, Maison Boulud features a patio on the upper level – boasting stunning views, it is perfect for al fresco dining. The elegant main space (lower level) has an oversized wine cellar displaying impressive vintages. Classic French cuisine, with more sophisticated plating, dominates the menu, but they also have a signature seafood platter, plus dishes infused with Asian touches, such as durian royale soufflé....
